pages.title: A gift shop · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Saturday morning in a gift shop in Belfast. Bags, scarves and clocks fill the shelves. Leo walks in and looks around. Blake stands behind the counter. He holds a brown leather bag. He asks Leo a question.
“Hi, Leo! Do you like this bag?” says Blake. “Yes! What is it made of?” says Leo. “It’s made of leather. It’s made in Italy.” says Blake.
